description: This file contains code for managing the execution and materialization of a Pi runtime used in documentation internationalization (i18n). It includes functions for resolving the command to run 'pi', checking whether to materialize the runtime, and installing it if necessary.

methods.name: resolveDocsPiCommand
methods.description: Determines the command to run the Pi runtime, either from environment variables, existing system path, or by ensuring it is materialized.

methods.name: shouldMaterializePiRuntime
methods.description: Checks if the existing Pi runtime path indicates that it should be materialized by inspecting the real path.

methods.name: ensureMaterializedPiRuntime
methods.description: Ensures that the Pi runtime is installed and ready to use by downloading and installing it if necessary.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiRuntimeDir
methods.description: Returns the directory where the materialized Pi runtime will be stored, using user cache directory or temporary directory.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiPackageVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the Pi package version from environment variable or defaults to '0.58.3'.
